reason: I pass a supermarket on my way home anyway and Tawfeer is only 5 or 6 minutes away, so I don't need someone to shop for me. And I want to choose my own vegetables and meat, which they don't do.
objection: They only do packaged staples, so I'd still have to go to the shop for the fresh things. Then why pay $1.25 a bag for something I already pick up on my way home?
would_change_my_mind: If they also picked fresh vegetables and meat the way I would, or if I could not get to the supermarket for a while, for example because I was ill or the car was in the garage.
